'''Mount Hideaway''' (Japanese: '''ミヤーザーキ山''' ''Mount Miyāzāki'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive mountain located near [[Pallet Town]]. The rugged area is home to [[Giant Pokémon|unusually large]] {{p|Onix}}. Something in the soil causes the Onix to grow to gigantic proportions. 

It is also a {{pkmn|training}} area for [[Kanto]] [[Elite Four]] member [[Bruno]]. While training for the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]], {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} decided to find him and seek his advice on training in ''[[EP071|To Master the Onixpected!]]''.
